description: Phase-3 capability proof for the software-supply-chain-assurance opportunity: add release-artifact integrity verification (verify artifact bytes vs a PUBLISHED hash — npm SRI sha512 'dist.integrity' or sha1 'dist.shasum') to odg-evidence-pack, reusing node crypto only. Matches the Sovereign-Tech/Liquid-Reply 'cryptographic verification of release artifacts' criterion. Proven on a REAL public npm release.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MISSION ODG_GLOBAL_ENTERPRISE_100K_500K_END_TO_END Phase 3 (execute a concrete deliverable slice).

work_item_contract.objective: verifyArtifactIntegrity(bytes, integrity) verifies a release artifact against its published hash (SRI sha256/384/512 base64, or npm sha1 shasum hex); fail-closed on mismatch/bad-format.
work_item_contract.scope: One pure function + export in odg-evidence-pack + hermetic tests; engine (supply-chain-attest) UNCHANGED; node crypto only; no network in tests. Live real-data proof in scratchpad only.
invariants: Pure + fail-closed (mismatch/unrecognised ⇒ ok:false; no false success).
No new primitive/orchestrator; reuses node crypto.
Hermetic tests (no network); live npm proof is scratchpad-only.
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic tests PASS (SRI-sha512 match, sha1 match, tamper⇒false, bad-format⇒false); tsc 0; dist bin runs verifyArtifactIntegrity on a REAL public npm artifact (left-pad@1.3.0) vs published integrity ⇒ ok:true; tamper on real data ⇒ mismatch; committed within write-set.
stop_conditions: A fix needs an engine source change or a path outside the write-set.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/bin/odg-evidence-pack.ts src/runtime/odg-evidence-pack.test.ts ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; delete contract; rebuild dist.
evidence_required: dist run on real npm artifact + tamper

objectives.goal: Release-artifact integrity verification vs published hash, proven on real public data.
done_when: Hermetic tests PASS; dist verifies a real npm artifact vs published integrity; tamper detected; committed.

definition_of_done: verifyArtifactIntegrity shipped + tested (hermetic) + proven on a REAL public npm release vs its published integrity + tamper-detected; committed (no force). A capability proof, NOT a client contract/reference.
